title: Voices Across Registers: Corpus-Conditioned Vernacular Jailbreaks against Aligned LLMs via Fanfiction Subgenres
abstract: arXiv:2606.04483v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing jailbreaks against aligned LLMs are discrete artifacts whose surface forms are easy to fingerprint and patch. We argue that the broader failure mode may lie not in any specific prompt, but in natural writing registers that safety tuning under-covers. Building on this insight, we introduce VAR, the first jailbreak family that uses real fanfiction subgenres as universal attack carriers: a creative-writing meta prompt is conditioned on passages from one of twelve Archive of Our Own (AO3) subgenres, and the harmful behavior is embedded as the climax of the resulting scene. The construction requires neither an adversarial attacker LLM nor optimization. On eight aligned LLMs over the union of HarmBench and JailbreakBench, this attack lifts mean ASR from 0.278 to 0.731 under a four-judge ensemble; a factorial decomposition shows the gain is carried by register rather than length or structure. Two active defenses widen rather than n

translated_title: 跨语域之声：利用同人小说子类型实现针对对齐大语言模型的语料库条件化白话越狱攻击
translated_abstract: 现有针对对齐大语言模型的越狱攻击是离散的产物，其表面形式很容易被指纹识别并修补。我们认为，更广泛的失效模式可能并不在于任何特定的提示词，而在于安全微调覆盖不足的自然写作语域。基于这一洞察，我们提出了VAR，这是首个以真实同人小说子类型作为通用攻击载体的越狱攻击家族：一个创意写作元提示词以Archive of Our Own（AO3）十二个子类型之一的段落作为条件，而有害行为则被嵌入为生成场景的高潮部分。这种构建既不需要对抗性攻击者大语言模型，也不需要优化过程。在八个对齐大语言模型上、于HarmBench和JailbreakBench的并集上进行测试，该攻击在四个评审器集成下将平均攻击成功率（ASR）从0.278提升至0.731；因子分解表明，这一提升来自语域本身，而非长度或结构。两种主动防御手段反而扩大而非缩小了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VAR——首个利用真实同人小说子类型作为通用攻击载体的越狱攻击家族，无需攻击者模型或优化过程，即可在八个对齐大语言模型上将平均攻击成功率从0.278提升至0.731，揭示了安全微调对自然写作语域覆盖不足这一根本性漏洞。
en_tdlr: VAR is the first jailbreak family that uses real fanfiction subgenres as universal attack carriers, lifting mean ASR on eight aligned LLMs from 0.278 to 0.731 without requiring an attacker LLM or optimization, revealing that safety tuning fundamentally under-covers natural writing registers.
